page.layout: One page of text in one column, with no marginal notes. Top: running head and page number. Then the continuation of a paragraph from the previous page, a short numbered heading, and the main paragraph running to the foot of the page. The right edge carries only the edge of the neighbouring page, which is not transcribed.

main_text.p: ei in hunc modum: Quoniam tu commi-sisti ut fœdus meum & instituta tibi à me tradita non conservares, eripiam ego tibi regnum, idq; servo tuo dabo. 3. Regum 11.

p.i: Sed Regina Vasti ad regis mandatum per spadones perlatum venire recusavit. Quare vehementi incensus ira Rex, sapientes rerum peritos (solebat enim rex omnibus legis iurisq; prudentibus negocia proponere: et erant tũ ei proximi Charsena, Sethar, Admatha, Tharsis, Mares, Marsana, & Mamuchan, septem Persarum Medorumq; principes, cum rege versantes, et in regno primum dignitatis locum obtinentes) hos inquam interrogat, quid fit Regina Vasti faciendum, quæ Regis Assueri mandato a spadonibus perlato non paruerit. Tum Mamuchan apud regem et proceres verba facit in hanc sententiam: Non solum in regem peccavit regina Vasti, sed etiam in omnes vel principes vel plebeios, qui sunt in omnibus regis Assueri provinciis. Omnes enim mulieres, divul-gata

page.notes: The first line begins with the fragment "ei", the end of a sentence from the previous page. "legis iurisq;" is printed as "legis'jurisq;" with an apostrophe-like mark after "legis"; read as printed. "tũ" is printed with a tilde over u. "Medorumq;" is printed with a superscript r. The marginal reference "3. Regum 11." is set at the line end within the text block and is transcribed in place. Numbers and abbreviations are as printed. Edge marks at the right edge are the neighbouring page and are omitted.
